function _pull(IERC20 token, uint256 amount) private { uint256 balBefore = token.balanceOf(address(this)); _call(address(token), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (msg.sender, address(this), amount))); require(token.balanceOf(address(this)) - balBefore == amount, "unsupported token (fee on transfer)"); }
